prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web UI canon comp
Primary request: Design a single 1600x1000 desktop website viewport for COVENANT, a premium institutional crypto-fintech product that turns a signed credit covenant into an enforceable, evidence-rich onchain payment facility. Show the real product meaning immediately: a borrower draws against a 10 CTC facility, 4 CTC is drawn, and a 5 USDC payment produces public evidence, then replay protection rejects duplicate settlement.
Scene/backdrop: edge-to-edge desktop web application canvas, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no poster presentation.
Style/medium: familiar high-craft institutional fintech web interface, precise product UI, dark navy-charcoal surfaces, disciplined typography, crisp dividers, restrained cobalt blue and mint green accents, subtle depth without glass effects.
Composition/framing: Full 1600x1000 first viewport. Top navigation with the exact wordmark "COVENANT" at upper left and concise nav items "Facility", "Evidence", "Protocol". Primary action at upper right: "View public evidence". Below, use a strong editorial two-column hierarchy rather than a grid of generic cards. Left side introduces "Programmable credit, proven onchain" with concise supporting copy: "Draw, pay, and verify every covenant event through public evidence." Include a prominent facility status module showing exact values "10 CTC Facility", "4 CTC Drawn", "6 CTC Available", and exact payment action/value "Pay 5 USDC". Right side carries a causal six-step timeline with clear numbered steps and connectors: "1 Payment initiated", "2 5 USDC transferred", "3 Sepolia receipt confirmed", "4 Covenant balance updated", "5 Evidence published", "6 Replay rejected". Make the sequence visibly causal from Sepolia payment through replay rejection. Lower viewport contains an "Evidence ledger" as a dense, professional table with rows for Payment, Receipt, Covenant Update, Evidence, and Replay Guard; include status pills such as Confirmed, Published, and Rejected, plus short transaction hashes, Sepolia labels, timestamps, and an obvious "Open evidence" action. Use compact annotations like "Publicly verifiable" and "Replay-safe".
Lighting/mood: sober, trustworthy, operational, premium, audit-ready.
Color palette: near-black navy #07101C, charcoal #0D1725, cool white #F4F7FB, muted slate #8492A6, restrained cobalt #2F6BFF, restrained mint #55D6A9. No purple.
Materials/textures: flat matte UI surfaces, subtle 1px borders, fine grid alignment, minimal shadow only where necessary.
Text (verbatim): "COVENANT"; "Facility"; "Evidence"; "Protocol"; "View public evidence"; "Programmable credit, proven onchain"; "Draw, pay, and verify every covenant event through public evidence."; "10 CTC Facility"; "4 CTC Drawn"; "6 CTC Available"; "Pay 5 USDC"; "1 Payment initiated"; "2 5 USDC transferred"; "3 Sepolia receipt confirmed"; "4 Covenant balance updated"; "5 Evidence published"; "6 Replay rejected"; "Evidence ledger"; "Payment"; "Receipt"; "Covenant Update"; "Evidence"; "Replay Guard"; "Confirmed"; "Published"; "Rejected"; "Open evidence"; "Publicly verifiable"; "Replay-safe".
Constraints: 1600x1000 landscape image, polished production-grade desktop interface, exact financial values, exact six-step causal timeline, evidence-first clarity, readable typography, coherent single-page hierarchy, public evidence action visible above the fold.
Avoid: device mockup, poster, generic card soup, neon fog, purple neon, gradients that resemble neon, glassmorphism, floating coins, token illustrations, fake trading charts, candlesticks, marketing illustrations, mascots, oversized abstract graphics, illegible microtext, clutter, cyberpunk styling, excessive rounded cards, watermarks.
